comments.title: Comments & Discussion
comments.description: View comments, add feedback, or mark as resolved here.

versionToggle.title: Filter Comment Versions
versionToggle.description: Switch between viewing all comments or only those for the current version.

compare.title: Version Comparison
compare.description: Visual comparison between two different versions.

attach.title: Attach File
attach.description: Attach images or documents to your comment.

link.title: Insert Link
link.description: Add a link to your comment.

draw.title: Draw/Annotate
draw.description: Draw directly on the image to illustrate your ideas.

headerVersion.title: Version Management
headerVersion.description: View history, switch versions, or upload a new version here.

headerShare.title: Share & Download
headerShare.description: Share the file link or download it directly to your device.

resizeHandle.title: Resize Handle
resizeHandle.description: Drag this bar left or right to change the comment pane width.

preview.title: View Image
preview.description: You can zoom in, zoom out, and move the image to see details.

previewMobile.title: View Image
previewMobile.description: Tap to zoom in/out and drag to move the image.

addCommentMobile.title: Add Comment
addCommentMobile.description: Enter your comment for the image here.

player.title: Video Player
player.description: Use keyboard shortcuts (Space to play/pause, Arrows to seek) to control.

timeline.title: Timeline & Markers
timeline.description: Markers on the timeline show the positions of comments and annotations.

timelineMobile.title: Timeline
timelineMobile.description: Tap the timeline to jump to that time. Red dots indicate comment positions.

exportFrame.title: Copy Frame
exportFrame.description: Click here to save the current frame image to your clipboard.

settings.title: Overlay Settings
settings.description: Open the menu to select Safe Zones and Composition Guides. Adjust colors and transparency.

fullscreen.title: Fullscreen
fullscreen.description: Enable fullscreen mode to see the video more clearly.

filterTime.title: Filter by Time
filterTime.description: Enable this to only show comments at the current timestamp.

navToggleMobile.title: Navigation Mode
navToggleMobile.description: Switch between controlling by frame (F) or marker (M).

preview.title: Image Sequence
preview.description: Browse through each frame using navigation buttons or arrow keys.

previewVideo.title: Image Sequence
previewVideo.description: Hover or drag to see the sequence quickly. Press Space for auto-play.

previewGrid.title: Image Sequence
previewGrid.description: Overview of all frames in the sequence. Click a frame for details.

viewMode.title: View Mode
viewMode.description: Switch between video, carousel, or grid modes to optimize your experience.

preview.title: View PDF
preview.description: Browse pages, zoom in/out, and switch pages to see details.

previewMobile.title: View PDF
previewMobile.description: Swipe to switch pages, tap to zoom.

preview.title: 3D Model
preview.description: Rotate, zoom, and adjust the view to see the model.

previewMobile.title: 3D Model
previewMobile.description: Tap and drag to rotate, pinch to zoom the model.

interactionMode.title: Interaction Mode
interactionMode.description: Switch between Rotate and Pan modes.

resetView.title: Reset View
resetView.description: Return to the default camera position.

screenshot.title: Screenshot
screenshot.description: Save a screenshot of the current view.

toolbar.title: Main Toolbar
toolbar.description: Contains controls for display, AR, and Animation.

arView.title: View AR
arView.description: View the model in real space (if supported by device).

renderMode.title: Render Mode
renderMode.description: Switch between Standard, Wireframe, or Matcap.

lighting.title: Display Settings
lighting.description: Adjust lighting, environment, and Tone Mapping.

preview.title: View & Browse
preview.description: Standard viewer for files. You can see the content and add feedback.
